profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer  @Virtumedical | .NET, Azure, DevOps
profile.summary:
As a Software Engineer II at Loxia Technologies Inc, I utilize my strong expertise in .NET technologies to design, develop, and maintain highly scalable and secure services for healthcare applications. I collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to gather requirements and translate them into technical specifications, following best practices and industry standards. 

In addition to my backend development skills, I occasionally contribute to frontend development tasks using Angular, creating user-friendly and visually appealing interfaces for seamless user experiences. I also oversee the deployment and management of healthcare applications on the Azure platform, leveraging various services and tools to ensure scalability, security, and high availability. I am passionate about creating innovative and impactful solutions for the healthcare sector, using my skills and knowledge to improve the lives of millions of users.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Utilize my strong expertise in .NET technologies to design, develop, and maintain highly scalable and secure services for healthcare applications.
Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to gather requirements and translate them into technical specifications.
Implement best practices and industry standards to ensure high-performance and maintainable code.
Occasionally contribute to frontend development tasks using Angular, creating user-friendly and visually appealing interfaces for seamless user experiences.
Oversee the deployment and management of healthcare applications on the Azure platform, leveraging various services and tools to ensure scalability, security, and high availability.
Implement continuous integration and deployment (CI/CD) pipelines to streamline application updates and releases.
Monitor and optimize the performance of Azure services, troubleshoot issues, and implement necessary improvements.
Design and develop SSIS packages to integrate, transform, and load data from various sources into healthcare systems.
Collaborate with data analysts and stakeholders to understand data requirements and ensure efficient and accurate data flow.
Perform regular maintenance and optimization of SSIS packages to improve data processing performance.

positions.title: Back End Developer
positions.description:
Managed both back-end and front-end aspects of development process.
Developed multiples solutions for company software using .Net framework, SLIM PHP, Cloud Based Applications

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Managed both back-end and front-end aspects of development process.
Completed code debugging and implemented fixes to resolve problems based on priority system.
Modified existing software systems to enhance performance and add new features. Created landing pages, dashboards and web applications using Symfony and Laravel. Troubleshot, tested and remedied issues before software deployment.
Defined and conducted design processes at all stages, including research, conceptualization, testing and implementation.

positions.title: Full Stack Developer
positions.description:
Managed both back-end and front-end aspects of development process.
Cultivated strategic customer relationships, evaluated needs and opportunities within customer accounts and negotiated to gain sales commitments.
Created and reviewed operational database assets for software releases.
Designed user-friendly software interfaces to simplify overall management.
